texts.preamble: Alex C.A vs The Designated Officer on 26 February, 2016 Author: P.B.Suresh Kumar Bench: P.B.Suresh Kumar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Honourable Mr. Justice P.B.Suresh Kumar Friday, The 24Th Day Of June 2016/3Rd Ashadha, 1938 WP(C).No. 19462 of 2016 (G) ---------------------------- Petitioner : --------------------- Alex C.A., Cheeran House, Kottapadi P.O., Guruvayoor, Pin - 680 505. By Adv. Sri.V.C.Madhavankutty
texts.facts: The petitioner has obtained a licence for packaging edible oils under the Food Safety and Standards Act ('the Act' for short). On inspection, the authorities under the Act found that the petitioner was keeping non- edible oil also in his premises. Consequently, notice was issued to suspend the licence granted to him. The petitioner challenged the said notice before this Court in WP.(C).No.7411 of 2016 and the said writ petition was disposed of by this Court directing that if the petitioner takes all the remedial measures as directed by the authorities under the Act, he shall be permitted to deal with edible oil. Ext.P3 is the judgment in the said case. Pursuant to Ext.P3 judgment, Ext.P11 communication was issued by the second respondent to the petitioner pointing out the remedial measures to be taken by him. According to the learned counsel, all the remedial measures suggested by the second respondent in Ext.P11 have been taken by the petitioner. Nevertheless, it is alleged that the authorities under the Act are not granting permission to the petitioner to commence the business.
